children.text: Discussing the Festival
Chen Jie, did you hear about the school music festival?
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 陈洁，你听说学校音乐节的事了吗？
children.notes: hear about = 听说
children.statement: 这句话是在询问对方是否知道某事。
children.explanation: Did you hear about... 是常用的询问句型。

children.text: Yeah, it sounds fun.
children.speaker: Chen Jie
children.cn: 是的，听起来很有趣。
children.notes: sound + adj. = 听起来……
children.statement: sounds 在这里是动词，意思是“听起来”。
children.explanation: Sound 在这里作为系动词，后接形容词。

children.text: Performance Concerns
Why don't you perform? You play the Chinese flute better than anyone else in our music club.
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 你为什么不表演呢？你在我们音乐俱乐部里笛子吹得比谁都好。
children.notes: better than = 比……更好
children.statement: better than 是 good 的比较级形式。
children.explanation: Good 的比较级是 better。

children.text: Well, I'm afraid of performing alone. I'm not as outgoing as you.
children.speaker: Chen Jie
children.cn: 嗯，我害怕独自表演。我没有你那么外向。
children.notes: afraid of = 害怕；not as...as = 不像……一样
children.statement: outgoing 的意思是“内向的”。
children.explanation: Outgoing 的意思是“外向的”。

children.text: Finding a Solution
But you work harder than me. And last week you played a really beautiful song!
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 但你比我更努力。而且上周你演奏了一首非常优美的曲子！
children.notes: harder than = 比……更努力
children.statement: harder 是 hard 的比较级。
children.explanation: Hard 的比较级是 harder。

children.text: You liked it? Maybe we could play it together!
children.speaker: Chen Jie
children.cn: 你喜欢吗？也许我们可以一起演奏！
children.notes: together = 一起
children.statement: together 的意思是“分开”。
children.explanation: Together 的意思是“一起”。

children.text: Great idea!
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 好主意！
children.notes: Great idea = 好主意
children.statement: 这句话表示赞同。
children.explanation: Great idea 是表示赞同对方提议的常用语。

children.text: Praising the Performance
I loved your performance! You two did a wonderful job!
children.speaker: Mrs Brown
children.cn: 我喜欢你们的表演！你们俩做得太棒了！
children.notes: wonderful job = 很棒的工作/表现
children.statement: loved 是 love 的过去式。
children.explanation: Loved 是 love 的过去式，表示过去喜欢。

children.text: Thank you!
children.speaker: Peter and Chen Jie
children.cn: 谢谢！
children.notes: 礼貌用语
children.statement: 这是对赞美的回应。
children.explanation: Thank you 是标准的礼貌回应。

children.text: Comparing Singing
Look, it's time for Ella and Emma's show!
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 看，到 Ella 和 Emma 的表演时间了！
children.notes: it's time for... = 是……的时间了
children.statement: 这句话是在提醒大家注意。
children.explanation: Look 在句首起引起注意的作用。

children.text: Is that Ella singing?
children.speaker: Mrs Brown
children.cn: 那是 Ella 在唱歌吗？
children.notes: singing 是 sing 的现在分词
children.statement: 这是一个一般疑问句。
children.explanation: Is 开头的句子是一般疑问句。

children.text: No, that's Emma. Emma is taller than Ella. And she sings louder than Ella.
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 不，那是 Emma。Emma 比 Ella 高。而且她唱歌比 Ella 大声。
children.notes: taller than = 比……高；louder than = 比……大声
children.statement: taller 是 tall 的比较级。
children.explanation: Tall 的比较级是 taller。

children.text: Comparing Dancing
Look! That is Ella dancing. Her hair is longer than Emma's.
children.speaker: Chen Jie
children.cn: 看！那是 Ella 在跳舞。她的头发比 Emma 的长。
children.notes: longer than = 比……长
children.statement: Emma's 在这里指 Emma's hair。
children.explanation: Emma's 是名词所有格，指代 Emma 的头发。

children.text: They both dance well, but I think Ella dances better than her sister.
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 她们俩舞都跳得很好，但我认为 Ella 跳得比她姐姐/妹妹好。
children.notes: dance well = 跳得好；better than = 比……好
children.statement: better 是 good 的比较级。
children.explanation: Better 是 good 或 well 的比较级。

tree.text: Emma and Ella: The Twins Interview

children.text: Part 1: Music Festival & Winning the Prize
Congratulations on winning the prize at the school music festival!
children.cn: 恭喜你们在学校音乐节上赢得了奖项！
children.notes: Congratulations on: 祝贺（做某事）；win the prize: 获奖
children.statement: 韩林对双胞胎在学校音乐节上获奖表示祝贺。
children.explanation: 韩林说的'Congratulations on winning the prize...'正是对双胞胎获奖表示祝贺。陈述正确。

children.text: Thank you!
children.cn: 谢谢你！
children.notes: Thank you!: 谢谢你(最基础的道谢语)
children.statement: 双胞胎礼貌地对韩林的祝贺表示了感谢。
children.explanation: 'Thank you!'是表达感谢的礼貌用语。陈述正确。
children.speaker: The twins
Han Lin

children.text: You attended the festival last year and this year.
children.cn: 你们去年和今年都参加了音乐节。
children.notes: attend: 出席，参加
children.statement: 双胞胎去年没有参加音乐节。
children.explanation: 句子中说'attended the festival last year and this year'，说明去年和今年都参加了。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: How is this year different?
children.cn: 今年有什么不同呢？
children.notes: different: 不同的，其名词形式是 difference
children.statement: 韩林在询问今年与去年的不同之处。
children.explanation: 韩林问'How is this year different?'（今年有什么不同？），是在询问差异。陈述正确。

children.text: There are more students and more activities this year.
children.cn: 今年有更多的学生 and 更多的活动。
children.notes: more: 更多的（many/much的比较级）
children.statement: 今年参加音乐节的学生人数和活动比去年减少了。
children.explanation: 句子使用'more students and more activities'表示“更多学生和更多活动”。因此陈述是错误的。
children.speaker: Ella

children.text: I think it is more colourful than last year.
children.cn: 我觉得它比去年更丰富多彩。
children.notes: more colourful than: 比……更丰富多彩；colourful的比较级是在前面加more
children.statement: 埃拉觉得今年的音乐节比去年更丰富多彩。
children.explanation: 埃拉说'I think it is more colourful than last year'，表达了今年的音乐节比去年更丰富多彩。陈述正确。
children.speaker: Ella
Han Lin
Han Lin

children.text: Part 2: Appearance & Personality Differences
As twins, you look very similar.
children.cn: 作为双胞胎，你们看起来非常相似。
children.notes: as: 作为；look similar: 看起来相似
children.statement: 作为双胞胎，她们俩在外观上毫无相似之处。
children.explanation: 韩林提到'you look very similar'（你们看起来非常相似）。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: How are you different?
children.cn: 你们有什么不同？
children.notes: different: 不同的（形容词）
children.statement: 韩林接着询问她们的不同之处。
children.explanation: 韩林问'How are you different?'（你们有什么不同？），引导对方比较各自的不同。陈述正确。

children.text: I'm a little quieter than Ella.
children.cn: 我比埃拉稍微安静一点。
children.notes: a little: 一点，修饰比较级；quieter: 更安静的（quiet的比较级）
children.statement: 埃玛比埃拉稍微外向一些。
children.explanation: 埃玛说'I'm a little quieter than Ella'，意为“我比埃拉稍微安静一些”。因此陈述是错误的。
children.speaker: Emma

children.text: And she is funnier than me.
children.cn: 而且她比我更有趣。
children.notes: funnier: 更滑稽的/更有趣的（funny的比较级，去y变i加er）
children.statement: 在埃玛看来，埃拉比她更幽默风趣。
children.explanation: 'she is funnier than me'中，'she'代指埃拉，意思是埃拉比埃玛更有趣。陈述正确。
children.speaker: Emma

children.text: Emma always gets up earlier than me.
children.cn: 埃玛总是比我起得早。
children.notes: earlier than: 比……早；earlier是early的比较级，去y变i加er
children.statement: 埃拉起得比埃玛要早。
children.explanation: 埃拉说'Emma always gets up earlier than me'，即埃玛比埃拉起得早。因此陈述是错误的。
children.speaker: Ella

children.text: Many people say I'm lazier than Emma, but that's not true!
children.cn: 许多人说我比埃玛懒，但那不是真的！
children.notes: lazier: 更懒的（lazy的比较级，去y变i加er）
children.statement: 许多人认为埃拉比埃玛要懒惰一些。
children.explanation: 句子前半句说'Many people say I'm lazier than Emma'（很多人说我比埃玛更懒）。陈述正确。
children.speaker: Ella

children.text: I work as hard as her!
children.cn: 我工作和她一样努力！
children.notes: as hard as: 和……一样努力/用功（as...as中间用原级）
children.statement: 埃拉实际上没有埃玛努力。
children.explanation: 埃拉反驳说'I work as hard as her!'（我工作和她一样努力！）。因此陈述是错误的。
children.speaker: Ella
Han Lin
Han Lin

children.text: Part 3: Spare Time Hobbies & Teamwork
That's really interesting.
children.cn: 那真的很有趣。
children.notes: really: 确实，真正地；interesting: 有趣的
children.statement: 韩林对埃拉刚才说的话感到很无聊。
children.explanation: 韩林说'That's really interesting'，表示“这真的很有趣”。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: Besides singing, how do you spend your spare time?
children.cn: 除了唱歌，你们如何度过空闲时间？
children.notes: besides: 除……之外(包括在内)；spare time: 空闲时间，相当于 free time
children.statement: 'Besides' 表示“除了……之外(包括在内)”，而不是排除在外。
children.explanation: 'Besides' 在此处引导介词短语，表示“除唱歌以外(包含唱歌)”。陈述正确。

children.text: I love playing sports more than anything.
children.cn: 我最喜欢做的事情就是做运动了。
children.notes: more than anything: 比任何事情都……(最……)
children.statement: 埃拉最喜欢做的事是运动。
children.explanation: 'love playing sports more than anything'表示最喜欢体育运动。陈述正确。
children.speaker: Ella

children.text: I like reading.
children.cn: 我喜欢读书。
children.notes: like doing sth: 喜欢做某事
children.statement: 埃玛也最喜欢运动。
children.explanation: 埃玛说'I like reading'（我喜欢看书），而不是运动。因此陈述是错误的。
children.speaker: Emma

children.text: You see, we're different in many ways, but together, we make a great team!
children.cn: 你看，我们在很多方面都不同，但在一起，我们是一个很棒的团队！
children.notes: in many ways: 在很多方面；make a great team: 组成一个优秀的团队
children.statement: 埃玛认为差异使得她们不能成为好伙伴。
children.explanation: 埃玛认为虽然有许多不同，但'together, we make a great team!'（在一起我们是一个很棒的团队）。因此陈述是错误的。
children.speaker: Emma
Han Lin
Han Lin

children.text: Thanks for talking with me.
children.cn: 谢谢你们与我交谈。
children.notes: thanks for doing sth: 因做某事而感谢
children.statement: 韩林对双胞胎接受采访表达了感谢。
children.explanation: 'Thanks for talking with me'是感谢对方接受谈话/采访。陈述正确。

children.text: Our pleasure!
children.cn: 我们的荣幸！
children.notes: Our pleasure!: 我们的荣幸/别客气(常用作答谢的客套语)
children.statement: 'Our pleasure!' 可以用来回答对方的感谢。
children.explanation: 'Our pleasure!' 意为“不用谢，这是我们的荣幸”，用于礼貌回答感谢。陈述正确。
children.speaker: The twins
Han Lin

tree.text: Online Forum: Should Friends Be Similar or Different?

children.text: Tom's Prompt: Should Friends Be Similar or Different?
Some people think that friends should be alike, but some other people think that friends should be different.
children.cn: 有些人认为朋友应该相似，但另一些人认为朋友应该不同。
children.notes: some... but some other...: 一些……但另一些……；be alike: 相似；be different: 不同
children.statement: 关于朋友应该相似还是不同，不同的人看法不一。
children.explanation: 句中指出'Some people think... but some other people think...'，说明人们对此有不同看法的陈述是正确的。

children.text: What do you think?
children.cn: 你怎么看？
children.notes: What do you think?: 你怎么看？/ 你认为呢？(表达询问观点)
children.statement: 汤姆在论坛中向大家征求关于朋友观点的看法。
children.explanation: 汤姆用'What do you think?'向读者询问看法。陈述正确。

children.text: Should friends be similar or different?
children.cn: 朋友应该相似还是不同？
children.notes: should: 应该；similar: 相似的；different: 不同的
children.statement: 汤姆提出的核心问题是朋友应该相似还是不同。
children.explanation: 汤姆问'Should friends be similar or different?'，提出了探讨的主题。陈述正确。

children.text: Matt's Opinion: Friends Are Like a Mirror
Matt's View on Friendship
I think a good friend is like a mirror.
children.cn: 我认为一个好朋友就像一面镜子。
children.notes: be like: 像……一样；mirror: 镜子
children.statement: 麦特认为好朋友和镜子有相似的作用。
children.explanation: 麦特说'a good friend is like a mirror'，他把好朋友比作镜子。陈述正确。

children.text: You can understand people by knowing their friends.
children.cn: 你可以通过了解一个人的朋友来了解这个人。
children.notes: by doing sth: 通过做某事(表示手段、方式)；know: 了解
children.statement: 'by knowing'在此处表示以……为手段或方式。
children.explanation: 介词'by'常与动名词连用，表示“通过……方式/手段”。陈述正确。

children.text: My friend, Stephen, is a great example.
children.cn: 我的朋友斯蒂芬就是个很好的例子。
children.notes: example: 例子，榜样；a great example: 一个极好的例子
children.statement: 麦特以他的朋友斯蒂芬为例来阐述上述观点。
children.explanation: 麦特接着提到'My friend, Stephen, is a great example'，用斯蒂芬作为具体的例子。陈述正确。

children.text: Stephen and Matt's Sports
We often hang out together because we have similar hobbies and interests.
children.cn: 我们经常一起出去玩，因为我们有相似的兴趣和爱好。
children.notes: hang out: 闲逛，一起玩；similar: 相似的；interests: 兴趣
children.statement: 麦特和斯蒂芬经常一起出去玩，因为他们性格截然不同。
children.explanation: 句子中明确说他们常一起玩是因为'similar hobbies and interests'（相似的爱好和兴趣）。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: For example, we both love sports.
children.cn: 例如，我们都热爱运动。
children.notes: For example: 例如；both: 双方都
children.statement: 斯蒂芬喜欢运动，但麦特不喜欢。
children.explanation: 句子使用'both'（两者都），表示两个人都热爱运动。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: He plays badminton better than I do, so he always wins our matches.
children.cn: 他羽毛球打得比我好，所以他总是赢我们的比赛。
children.notes: plays badminton: 打羽毛球；better than: 比……更好(well的比较级)；match: 比赛
children.statement: 在他们之间的羽毛球赛中，麦特通常是赢家。
children.explanation: 麦特说'he always wins our matches'（斯蒂芬总是赢），所以赢家是斯蒂芬而不是麦特。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: Because of that, I try harder when I practise, and now I'm getting better at badminton.
children.cn: 正因如此，我在练习时更加努力，现在我的羽毛球技术也越来越好了。
children.notes: Because of: 因为(后接名词或代词短语)；get better at: 在……方面做得更好
children.statement: 'Because of'后面可以直接跟一个完整的句子。
children.explanation: 'Because of'是介词短语，后接名词、代词或动名词，不能接完整的句子。接句子需要用连词'because'。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: Stephen and Matt's Shared Hobbies
Stephen and I are similar in other ways.
children.cn: 斯蒂芬和我在其他方面也有相似之处。
children.notes: be similar in: 在……方面相似；other ways: 其他方面
children.statement: 除了体育运动，斯蒂芬和麦特在其他方面没有共同点。
children.explanation: 句子明确说'are similar in other ways'（在其他方面也相似）。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: He is as serious as me.
children.cn: 他和我一样严肃。
children.notes: as...as...: 和……一样……，中间使用形容词或副词的原级
children.statement: 斯蒂芬比麦特要更严肃一些。
children.explanation: 句中结构'as serious as me'表示“和我一样严肃”，并不存在谁比谁更严肃。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: When we aren't playing sports, we enjoy reading together.
children.cn: 当我们不去做运动的时候，我们喜欢在一起看书。
children.notes: enjoy doing sth: 享受/喜欢做某事；together: 一起
children.statement: 当他们不运动时，他们各玩各的，不在一起看书。
children.explanation: 句子说'we enjoy reading together'（我们喜欢一起看书）。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: I read more history books than he does, and he reads a lot of novels.
children.cn: 我读的历史书比他多，而他读很多小说。
children.notes: more...than...: 比……更多；history books: 历史书；a lot of: 许多的，大量的；novel: 小说
children.statement: 句中的 'does' 是助动词，用来替代 'reads history books' 以避免重复。
children.explanation: 这里的 'does' 是助动词，在此处用以替代 'reads history books'，起到了避免重复的作用。陈述正确。

children.text: We often share interesting books with each other.
children.cn: 我们经常彼此分享有趣的书籍。
children.notes: share sth with sb: 和某人分享某物；each other: 彼此，互相
children.statement: 麦特和斯蒂芬经常把各自有趣的书推荐或分享给对方。
children.explanation: 句子说'share interesting books with each other'，说明他们常彼此分享有趣的书籍。陈述正确。

children.text: Diana's Opinion: Differences Make Me Better
Diana's View on Differences
I don't agree.
children.cn: 我不同意。
children.notes: agree: 同意；disagree: 不同意
children.statement: 戴安娜赞同麦特关于朋友应该是相似的的看法。
children.explanation: 戴安娜直接说'I don't agree'，表达她有不同的看法。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: For me, friends who are different make me better.
children.cn: 对我来说，不同的朋友能让我变得更好。
children.notes: For me: 对我而言；who are different: 定语从句，修饰friends；make sb do sth: 使某人……(此处为 make sb + 形容词)
children.statement: 戴安娜认为和性格各异的朋友相处有助于提升自己。
children.explanation: 戴安娜指出差异能'make me better'（让我变得更好）。陈述正确。

children.text: I think we should respect each other's differences and learn from each other.
children.cn: 我认为我们应该尊重彼此的差异，互相学习。
children.notes: respect: 尊重；differences: 差异(difference的复数形式)；learn from sb: 向某人学习
children.statement: 戴安娜建议我们应当尊重朋友之间的差异，并取长补短。
children.explanation: 句子明确提出 'respect each other's differences and learn from each other'（尊重差异，互相学习）。陈述正确。

children.text: Diana's Best Friend Yuan Lei
For example, I am kind of shy, but my best friend, Yuan Lei, is outgoing.
children.cn: 例如，我有点内向害羞，但我最好的朋友袁蕾却很外向。
children.notes: kind of: 有点儿；best friend: 最好的朋友；outgoing: 外向的
children.statement: 戴安娜最好的朋友袁蕾和她一样，也是个害羞的人。
children.explanation: 戴安娜说'I am kind of shy, but my best friend, Yuan Lei, is outgoing'（袁蕾很外向）。因此陈述是错误的。
children.keywords: kind of shy, Yuan Lei, outgoing

children.text: She has a great sense of humour too.
children.cn: 而且她也很有幽默感。
children.notes: have a sense of humour: 有幽默感；great: 极好的
children.statement: 袁蕾非常有幽默感。
children.explanation: 戴安娜说'She has a great sense of humour too'，这说明袁蕾是一个很幽默的人。陈述正确。

children.text: Thanks to her, I am becoming more outgoing.
children.cn: 多亏了她，我正变得越来越外向。
children.notes: Thanks to: 多亏了，由于(后接名词或代词短语)；becoming: 变得(现在进行时，表示逐渐变化)；more outgoing: 更外向(outgoing的比较级)
children.statement: 在袁蕾的影响下，戴安娜正变得越来越开朗外向。
children.explanation: 戴安娜说'Thanks to her, I am becoming more outgoing'，证实了这一点。陈述正确。

children.text: Now I think meeting new people is really fun!
children.cn: 现在我觉得结识新朋友真的很有趣！
children.notes: meeting new people: 结识新朋友(动名词作宾语)；really fun: 真的很有趣
children.statement: 戴安娜现在仍然害怕认识新朋友。
children.explanation: 戴安娜说'Now I think meeting new people is really fun!'（觉得认识新朋友很有趣）。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: Diana's Honest Friend Zhang Yong
I have another friend, Zhang Yong.
children.cn: 我还有一个朋友，叫张勇。
children.notes: another: 另一个，又一个
children.statement: 张勇是戴安娜唯一的外国朋友。
children.explanation: 文中没有任何关于张勇国籍的内容，且张勇是中文名，通常不是外国人。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: He is not afraid to give his opinion, especially when he thinks I am making a mistake.
children.cn: 他不怕发表自己的看法，特别是在他认为我犯错误的时候。
children.notes: be afraid to do sth: 害怕做某事；opinion: 看法，意见；especially: 尤其，特别；make a mistake: 犯错
children.statement: 当戴安娜犯错误时，张勇会因为害怕而不敢直言。
children.explanation: 句子说明张勇'is not afraid to give his opinion... when he thinks I am making a mistake'（不怕提出他的意见）。因此陈述是错误的。
children.keywords: not afraid, give opinion, making a mistake

children.text: I am less straightforward than he is, but I am glad to have an honest friend.
children.cn: 我不像他那么坦率，但我很高兴能有一个诚实的朋友。
children.notes: less straightforward than: 不如……坦率(straightforward的否定比较级)；be glad to do sth: 高兴做某事；honest: 诚实的
children.statement: 戴安娜觉得自己比张勇更直爽坦率。
children.explanation: 戴安娜说'I am less straightforward than he is'，意为“我不像他那么坦率”。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: Two Alike Characters & Exchanged Lives
children.cn: 容貌相似的主角与互换人生

children.text: The prince, Edward, and the poor boy, Tom, are the two main characters in Mark Twain's famous novel The Prince and the Pauper.
children.keywords: prince Edward, poor boy Tom, main characters, novel
children.cn: 爱德华王子和穷孩子汤姆是马克·吐温著名小说《乞丐王子》中的两个主角。
children.statement: 爱德华王子和汤姆是马克·吐温著名小说中的两个主角。
children.explanation: 文中指出两人是小说 'The Prince and the Pauper' 中的主角。陈述正确。

children.text: They looked alike and both had kind personalities.
children.cn: 他们长得很像，而且都有善良的性格。
children.statement: 他们两人不仅外表长得很像，而且性格都很善良。
children.explanation: 文中写道 'They looked alike and both had kind personalities'。陈述正确。

children.text: They exchanged their lives by accident.
children.cn: 他们偶然互换了彼此的生活。
children.statement: 他们是故意精心策划调换各自生活的。
children.explanation: by accident 意为“偶然地/意外地”，并非蓄意调换。陈述错误。

children.text: Life Lessons & Making a Difference
children.cn: 民间体悟与发挥影响

children.text: During his time as a pauper, Edward learnt to respect others.
children.keywords: time as pauper, learnt to respect others
children.cn: 在作为贫儿的那段时光里，爱德华学会了尊重他人。
children.statement: 在体验贫儿生活的日子里，爱德华学会了尊重他人。
children.explanation: 文中明确提到 'Edward learnt to respect others'。陈述正确。

children.text: Besides this, he also realized that people's lives were much harder than he expected.
children.keywords: besides, realized, lives harder than expected
children.cn: 除此之外，他还意识到百姓的生活比他预想的要艰难得多。
children.statement: 爱德华发现百姓的生活比他想象的更加轻松优渥。
children.explanation: 文中提到百姓生活比他预想的要艰辛得多（much harder than he expected）。陈述错误。

children.text: After becoming king, he made a difference by trying to help the people of his country.
children.keywords: becoming king, made a difference, help people
children.cn: 成为国王后，他尽力帮助国家的人民，从而发挥了重要影响。
children.statement: 成为国王后，爱德华努力帮助国家的人民，做出了积极贡献。
children.explanation: made a difference 意为“产生积极影响，做出贡献”。陈述正确。

tree.text: Rose's Post: Friends Similar or Different
tree.cn: 罗斯的帖子：朋友相似还是不同

children.text: Rose's View on Friendship
I don't really care if my friends are similar to or different from me.
children.cn: 我其实不在乎我的朋友是和我很像还是和我不同。
children.notes: really care: 在乎；if: 是否；be similar to: 与……相似；be different from: 与……不同
children.statement: 罗斯很在乎朋友是否和自己有相似的性格。
children.explanation: 罗斯说'I don't really care...'（我其实不在乎），所以陈述是错误的。
children.keywords: don't care, similar to, different from

children.text: I have two amazing friends.
children.cn: 我有两个棒极了的朋友。
children.notes: amazing: 棒极了的，令人惊喜的
children.statement: 罗斯有两个非常优秀的朋友。
children.explanation: 罗斯说'I have two amazing friends'，陈述正确。

children.text: Rose's Funny Friend Lily
Lily is funnier than anyone else I know.
children.cn: 莉莉比我认识的任何人都更有趣。
children.notes: funnier than: 比……更有趣(funny的比较级)；anyone else: 其他任何人
children.statement: 莉莉是罗斯认识的人里最风趣幽默的。
children.explanation: 句中'funnier than anyone else I know'表示“比我认识的任何人都更有趣”。陈述正确。

children.text: When I feel sad or have a problem, she makes me laugh and feel better.
children.cn: 当我感到难过或遇到问题时，她会逗我笑，让我感觉好一些。
children.notes: feel sad: 感到难过；have a problem: 有困难/问题；make sb do sth: 让某人做某事；feel better: 感觉好些
children.statement: 当罗斯心情不好时，莉莉总是能让她高兴起来。
children.explanation: 句中提到'makes me laugh and feel better'说明莉莉能让罗斯感觉好起来。陈述正确。
children.keywords: feel sad, problem, makes me laugh, feel better

children.text: She helps me see the silver lining in difficult situations.
children.cn: 她帮助我在困境中看到积极希望的一面。
children.notes: silver lining: 困境中的一线光明/希望(习语)；difficult situation: 困境，艰难处境
children.statement: 习语 'silver lining' 指的是困境中积极、希望的一面。
children.explanation: 习语'silver lining'来自谚语'Every cloud has a silver lining'，意为困境中的一线光明。陈述正确。
children.keywords: helps me, silver lining, difficult situations

children.text: Rose's Quiet Friend Lucy
My other friend, Lucy, is not as funny as Lily.
children.cn: 我的另一个朋友露西不如莉莉那么幽默。
children.notes: not as... as...: 不如……那样……
children.statement: 露西比莉莉更加幽默。
children.explanation: 句中说'not as funny as Lily'（不如莉莉幽默）。因此陈述是错误的。
children.keywords: other friend, Lucy, not as funny as

children.text: Lucy is quieter, but she listens better than others.
children.cn: 露西更安静，但她比其他人更善于倾听。
children.notes: quieter: 更安静的(quiet的比较级)；listens better: 倾听得更好
children.statement: 露西性格安静，但她非常擅长倾听他人。
children.explanation: 罗斯说'she listens better than others'，说明露西很善于倾听。陈述正确。

children.text: Lucy and I talk about everything.
children.cn: 露西和我无所不谈。
children.notes: talk about: 谈论；everything: 一切事物
children.statement: 罗斯和露西交流很少，有很多不能说的秘密。
children.explanation: 罗斯说'talk about everything'（无所不谈）。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: I know she cares about me because she's always there to listen.
children.cn: 我知道她关心我，因为她总是随时在那里倾听。
children.notes: care about: 关心，在意；because: 因为；be always there to do sth: 总是随时准备做某事
children.statement: 露西通过耐心倾听来表达对罗斯的关心。
children.explanation: 句中说'she cares about me because she's always there to listen'。陈述正确。
children.keywords: cares about, because, always there, listen

children.text: Rose's Favourite Saying on Friendship
My favourite saying is, "A true friend reaches for your hand and touches your heart."
children.cn: 我最喜欢的名言是：“真正的朋友是伸手拉住你的手，触动你的心灵的人。”
children.notes: favourite saying: 最喜欢的名言/谚语；reach for: 伸手去拿/拉；touch one's heart: 触动某人的心
children.statement: 罗斯最喜欢的一句格言阐述了真正朋友的真谛。
children.explanation: 这句名言说明了真朋友能给人以关怀和心灵的触动。陈述正确。
children.keywords: favourite saying, true friend, reaches hand, touches heart

children.text: Both Lily and Lucy are true friends.
children.cn: 莉莉和露西都是真正的朋友。
children.notes: Both...and...: 既……又……，两者都；true friend: 真正的朋友
children.statement: 罗斯认为莉莉和露西中只有一个人是真正的朋友。
children.explanation: 句中使用'Both Lily and Lucy'（莉莉和露西两者都），说明她们都是真正的朋友。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: We are always ready to help each other by lending a hand.
children.cn: 我们总是随时准备伸出援手互相帮助。
children.notes: be ready to do sth: 准备好做某事；help each other: 互相帮助；lend a hand: 伸出援手/帮忙(习语)
children.statement: 习语 'lend a hand' 意思是“伸出援手，给予帮助”。
children.explanation: 习语'lend a hand'意为伸出援手提供帮助。陈述正确。
children.keywords: ready to help, each other, lending a hand

children.text: The Four Brothers and Their Special Abilities
Once upon a time, there were four brothers.
children.cn: 从前，有兄弟四人。
children.notes: Once upon a time: 从前，很久以前（童话故事常见开头）
children.statement: 这个故事发生在现代的大都市里。
children.explanation: 'Once upon a time'表示“从前，很久以前”，通常是传统童话故事的开头，并非发生在现代大都市。因此陈述是错误的。
children.keywords: Once upon a time, four brothers

children.text: "I can see farther than anyone," the first brother said.
children.cn: “我能看得比任何人都远，”老大说。
children.notes: farther than: 比……更远（far的比较级）
children.statement: 老大认为自己视力最好，能看得最远。
children.explanation: 老大说'I can see farther than anyone'（我能看得比任何人都远），这说明他视力最好。陈述正确。

children.text: "At the top of that tree, there are five eggs in a nest."
children.cn: “在那棵树的顶端，鸟窝里有五只蛋。”
children.notes: at the top of: 在……顶端；nest: 鸟窝，鸟巢
children.statement: 树顶的鸟窝里有四只鸟蛋。
children.explanation: 老大说'there are five eggs in a nest'（鸟窝里有五只蛋）。因此陈述是错误的。
children.keywords: top of tree, five eggs, nest

children.text: "I am faster than all of you—I move as quickly as a cat," said the second brother.
children.cn: “我比你们所有人都快——我动作像猫一样敏捷，”老二说。
children.notes: faster than: 比……更快速；as quickly as: 和……一样敏捷/快速
children.statement: 老二动作迟缓，速度不如其他兄弟。
children.explanation: 老二说'I am faster than all of you—I move as quickly as a cat'（我比你们都快）。因此陈述是错误的。
children.keywords: faster than, quickly as a cat

children.text: He climbed up, took the eggs quietly, and then put them back.
children.cn: 他爬上去，悄悄地取走鸟蛋，然后再把它们放了回去。
children.notes: climb up: 爬上去；take...quietly: 悄悄取走；put back: 放回原处
children.statement: 老二爬树取走鸟蛋后把蛋带回家煮着吃了。
children.explanation: 文中说老二取走鸟蛋后'then put them back'（然后再把它们放了回去）。因此陈述是错误的。
children.keywords: climbed up, took eggs, put back

children.text: The bird never noticed it.
children.cn: 那只鸟一点也没有察觉。
children.notes: never: 从未，绝不；notice: 察觉，注意到
children.statement: 老二取蛋和放蛋的过程没有惊动大鸟。
children.explanation: 'The bird never noticed it'说明鸟完全没有注意到蛋被动过。陈述正确。

children.text: "I can shoot better than all of you," said the third.
children.cn: “我的射术比你们所有人都好，”老三说。
children.notes: shoot better than: 射得比……更好
children.statement: 老三射箭的本领在兄弟四人中是最好的。
children.explanation: 老三说'I can shoot better than all of you'（我射得比你们所有人都好）。陈述正确。

children.text: He then shot a leaf above the nest.
children.cn: 接着他射中了鸟窝上方的一片树叶。
children.notes: above: 在……上方
children.statement: 老三直接一箭射穿了鸟窝里的鸟蛋。
children.explanation: 文中说老三'shot a leaf above the nest'（射中了鸟窝上方的一片树叶），并没有射鸟蛋。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: The fourth brother said, "I can sew anything together, even something as soft as that leaf."
children.cn: 老四说：“我可以缝合任何东西，哪怕是像那片树叶一样柔软的东西。”
children.notes: sew...together: 缝合在一起；as soft as: 像……一样柔软
children.statement: 老四擅长缝纫，能缝合极其柔软的东西。
children.explanation: 老四说能缝合任何东西，哪怕是像树叶一样柔软的东西。陈述正确。

children.text: In no time, the leaf was as good as new.
children.cn: 不一会儿，那片树叶就完好如初了。
children.notes: In no time: 立刻，马上，不一会儿；as good as new: 完好如初
children.statement: 老四花了整整三天才把破树叶缝补好。
children.explanation: 'In no time'表示“立刻，不一会儿”，老四缝补树叶非常迅速。因此陈述是错误的。
children.keywords: In no time, as good as new

children.text: Rescuing the Princess from the Dragon
Not long after, the king's daughter was taken away by a dragon.
children.cn: 没过多久，国王的女儿被一条巨龙抓走了。
children.notes: Not long after: 没过多久；be taken away by: 被……带走/抓走
children.statement: 公主是被邻国的王子抢走的。
children.explanation: 文中明确说是'taken away by a dragon'（被一条巨龙抓走）。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: The king said whoever brought the princess back could marry her.
children.cn: 国王说，无论谁把公主救回来，就可以娶她为妻。
children.notes: whoever: 无论谁，任何人；bring...back: 带回，救回；marry: 娶，嫁
children.statement: 国王承诺只要救回公主，就可以娶公主为妻。
children.explanation: 国王承诺'whoever brought the princess back could marry her'。陈述正确。

children.text: The first brother said, "I see her! She is far away, on a rock at sea, with the dragon."
children.cn: 老大说：“我看到她了！她在很远的地方，在海边的一块岩石上，和巨龙在一起。”
children.notes: far away: 在远方；at sea: 在海上/海边
children.statement: 老大凭着出色的视力发现公主被关在海边岩石上。
children.explanation: 老大看得最远，他发现了公主的位置。陈述正确。
children.keywords: see her, far away, rock at sea

children.text: So the brothers sailed to the rock.
children.cn: 于是兄弟们驾船驶向那块岩石。
children.notes: sail to: 航行至，驾船驶向
children.statement: 兄弟四人骑着飞马前往那块岩石。
children.explanation: 文中说'brothers sailed to the rock'（驾船驶向岩石）。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: The third brother said, "I may hurt the princess if I shoot the dragon."
children.cn: 老三说：“如果我射击巨龙，可能会伤到公主。”
children.notes: may: 可能；hurt: 伤害；if: 如果（引导条件状语从句）
children.statement: 老三担心射杀巨龙时会误伤到公主。
children.explanation: 老三说'I may hurt the princess if I shoot the dragon'，表达了他的顾虑。陈述正确。

children.text: "Leave it to me," said the second brother.
children.cn: “交给我吧，”老二说。
children.notes: Leave it to me: 交给我吧 / 让我来处理
children.statement: 老二主动承担了救公主的任务。
children.explanation: 'Leave it to me'意思是“交给我吧”，老二主动请缨。陈述正确。

children.text: He moved as quietly as a mouse and quickly freed the princess.
children.cn: 他动作像老鼠一样轻巧安静，迅速解救了公主。
children.notes: as quietly as a mouse: 像老鼠一样安静；free: 解救，释放
children.statement: 老二凭借轻巧敏捷的身手救出了公主。
children.explanation: 老二'moved as quietly as a mouse and quickly freed the princess'，完成了解救。陈述正确。
children.keywords: as quietly as a mouse, freed princess

children.text: Suddenly, the dragon began to chase them.
children.cn: 突然，巨龙开始追赶他们。
children.notes: Suddenly: 突然；begin to do sth: 开始做某事；chase: 追赶，追捕
children.statement: 巨龙在睡大觉，根本没有追赶他们。
children.explanation: 文中说'Suddenly, the dragon began to chase them'（巨龙开始追赶他们）。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: The third brother shot it, but its fall broke their ship.
children.cn: 老三射中了巨龙，但巨龙掉下来砸坏了他们的船。
children.notes: shot: 射击（shoot的过去式）；fall: 坠落；break: 砸碎，打破（broke是break的过去式）
children.statement: 老三射中巨龙后，掉落的龙尸砸坏了他们的船只。
children.explanation: 老三射杀巨龙后'its fall broke their ship'（坠落砸坏了船）。陈述正确。
children.keywords: third brother shot, fall broke ship

children.text: Luckily, the fourth brother took his needle and sewed the ship together.
children.cn: 幸运的是，老四拿出了针，把船缝合在了一起。
children.notes: Luckily: 幸运的是；needle: 针；sew...together: 缝合在一起
children.statement: 船坏了之后，老四用针线把船给重新缝补好了。
children.explanation: 老四'took his needle and sewed the ship together'（拿针把船缝合在一起）。陈述正确。

children.text: Then they sailed home safely.
children.cn: 然后他们安全地驾船回到了家。
children.notes: sail home: 驾船回家；safely: 安全地（副词修饰sail）
children.statement: 船沉没了，兄弟四人和公主都淹死了。
children.explanation: 文中说缝好船后'they sailed home safely'（安全地驾船回家）。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: The King's Wisdom & Unity
The happy king asked, "Which of you will marry my daughter?"
children.cn: 高兴的国王问：“你们当中哪一位要娶我的女儿？”
children.notes: Which of you: 你们当中的哪一个；marry: 娶，结婚
children.statement: 国王反悔了，不打算让任何一个兄弟娶公主。
children.explanation: 国王高兴地问'Which of you will marry my daughter?'（你们谁娶我女儿？），履行了诺言。因此陈述是错误的。
children.keywords: Which of you, marry my daughter

children.text: The brothers began to argue.
children.cn: 兄弟们开始争论起来。
children.notes: begin to do sth: 开始做某事；argue: 争论，争吵
children.statement: 兄弟们互相谦让，谁都不愿意娶公主。
children.explanation: 文中说'The brothers began to argue'（兄弟们开始争论/争执起来）。因此陈述是错误的。

children.text: Each brother believed that he did more than the others.
children.cn: 每个兄弟都认为自己比其他人贡献更大。
children.notes: Each: 每个；believe that: 相信，认为（引导宾语从句）；do more than: 做得比……更多
children.statement: 每个兄弟都觉得自己出力最多、功劳最大。
children.explanation: 每个兄弟都认为'he did more than the others'（自己比别人做得多）。陈述正确。
children.keywords: Each brother, did more than others

children.text: Finally, the king said, "Each of you is as good as the others, but you are much stronger together."
children.cn: 最后，国王说：“你们每个人都和其他人一样出色，但你们团结在一起时要强大得多。”
children.notes: as good as: 和……一样出色；much stronger together: 在一起强得多（much修饰比较级）
children.statement: 国王认为只有老大功劳最大，其他三人一无是处。
children.explanation: 国王说'Each of you is as good as the others'（每个人都一样出色）。因此陈述是错误的。
children.keywords: Each of you, as good as, stronger together

children.text: "Instead, I give half of my kingdom to you as a reward."
children.cn: “相反，我把我的半个王国分给你们作为奖励。”
children.notes: Instead: 取而代之，相反；half of: ……的一半；as a reward: 作为报酬/奖赏
children.statement: 国王决定把半个王国平分给兄弟四人作为奖赏。
children.explanation: 国王说'give half of my kingdom to you as a reward'。陈述正确。
children.keywords: half of my kingdom, as a reward

children.text: The brothers were pleased.
children.cn: 兄弟们很高兴。
children.notes: pleased: 高兴的，满意的
children.statement: 兄弟四人对国王的处理结果非常满意。
children.explanation: 'The brothers were pleased'说明他们感到高兴和满意。陈述正确。

children.text: It was much better to share than to fight.
children.cn: 分享可比争斗要好得多。
children.notes: It is + adj. + to do A than to do B: 做A比做B更……；share: 分享；fight: 争斗，打架
children.statement: 兄弟们领悟到了“分享胜于争斗”的道理。
children.explanation: 'It was much better to share than to fight'强调了分享优于争斗。陈述正确。
children.keywords: better to share than to fight
